note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I need the actual content.

Right now I only have placeholders:
- Transcript: {transcript}
- Differential Diagnosis (DDx): {ddx}

Please provide:
- The verbatim transcript of the patient encounter (doctor-patient dialogue), or paste the relevant clinical notes.
- The DDx in JSON format as provided by the diagnostic agent (include any available likelihood tags).

Once received, I will produce:
Subjective:
- Presenting complaint, onset/duration/progression
- Past medical history, surgeries
- Medications
- Social history
- Allergies

Objective:
- Physical examination findings (specific sites, sides, any pertinent details)
- Vitals and investigations/results (if provided)

Assessment & Plan:
1. Issue/Problem/Request 1 (name only):
   - Assessment
   - Differential diagnoses (from DDx only if consistent; note conflict if applicable)
   - Investigations planned
   - Treatments planned
   - Referrals (if any)

2. Issue/Problem/Request 2 (name only):
   - As above

3. Issue/Problem/Request 3, 4, 5, etc. (if applicable):
   - As above

Quality checks (at bottom):
- Missing but clinically expected elements (e.g., allergies, meds reconciliation)
- Internal conflicts between transcript and DDx (mark “conflict noted”)
- Brief comment on transcript quality if noisy/inaudible

Notes on constraints:
- Do not insert any facts not present in the transcript or DDx.
- If a med is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, record the name and add “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- If the transcript and DDx conflict, include both and mark “conflict noted.”
- Use American English; concise, professional tone.
- Use the exact structure and headings as requested.

Please paste the transcript and the DDx JSON, and I’ll generate the complete note.
